summary: The 8-K reports a 5-for-1 forward split of shares of the abrdn Physical Palladium Shares ETF effective May 18, 2026. The split increased shares outstanding from 6,112,500 to 30,562,500 and reduced net asset value per share from $128.69 to $25.74. There are no deal terms, premiums, or change-of-control implications; this is a routine capital adjustment. No special-situation event is present, and the filing merely reflects the mechanical effect of the split. No additional structural or regulatory aspects warrant classification beyond a standard corporate action.
